conditions: The map operand is a set containing only pairs, and the curly-brace reference form is used.
limitations: This claim concerns a map reference in an expression and excludes assignment and the distinct parenthesized form.

triggers: Check any correction to the cited text or archive representation.

statement: Dewar's 1979 SETL reference describes a brace map reference as yielding the set of range values of all pairs matching the supplied domain value. If no pair matches, the reference yields the empty set.
